title: Methodology Change to the PHLX Semiconductor Sector Index
主要内容: NASDAQ OMX Group announced a methodology change to the PHLX Semiconductor Sector Index (Nasdaq:SOX) effective September 2013. The Index will undergo an annual evaluation in September, using market data as of the end of July. The top 30 eligible securities based on market capitalization will be included. Security additions and deletions will take effect after the close of trading on the third Friday in September. The first Annual Evaluation will coincide with the regular September Quarterly Rebalance. Changes will become effective prior to market open on September 23, 2013, with a list of additions and deletions announced on September 13, 2013.
